prompt: 哪一句的假設語氣（與過去事實相反）正確？
options: If I had left earlier, I would have caught the train.
If I left earlier, I would have caught the train.
If I had left earlier, I will catch the train.
answer: If I had left earlier, I would have caught the train.

wrong.If I left earlier, I would have caught t: 與過去事實相反，if 子句要用過去完成式 had left，不是過去式。
wrong.If I had left earlier, I will catch the: 主句也要配合過去，用 would have caught，不能用 will catch。

why: 與過去事實相反：If + had + p.p., would have + p.p.。
tip: 過去的假設：had p.p. + would have p.p.。
say: If I had left earlier, I would have caught the train.

text: Had she studied harder, she _____ the exam.
options: would have passed
would pass
will have passed

wrong.would pass: Had she studied 表示對過去的假設，主句要用 would have passed。
wrong.will have passed: will have passed 是對未來的預測，不是對過去的假設。

why: Had + 主詞 + p.p. 是省略 If 的倒裝，主句用 would have + p.p.。
tip: Had + 主詞 + p.p. 等於 If 過去完成。
say: Had she studied harder, she would have passed the exam.

prompt: 這句話的真實情況是什麼？
text: If only I had asked for help earlier.
options: 我當時沒有及早求助，現在後悔
我一直都及早求助
我以後會及早求助
answer: 我當時沒有及早求助，現在後悔

wrong.我一直都及早求助: If only + 過去完成式表示後悔，說明事實剛好相反。
wrong.我以後會及早求助: 句子是 had asked，談的是過去，不是未來的計畫。

why: If only + had p.p. 表示對過去的遺憾，事實是當時沒有開口求助。
tip: If only + had p.p. = 好希望當初…
say: If only I had asked for help earlier.

prompt: 朋友對選擇題用猜的答對了，你想提醒：「答對不代表真的懂，還是要確認。」
options: Getting it right doesn't mean you understand it.
Getting it right doesn't mean you understanding it.
To get it right don't means you understand it.
answer: Getting it right doesn't mean you understand it.

wrong.Getting it right doesn't mean you unders: mean 後面接 that 子句，需要完整動詞 understand，不能用 understanding。
wrong.To get it right don't means you understa: 助動詞用 doesn't mean，don't 與 means 的搭配不對，一句話出現兩個動詞變化。

why: 動名詞 Getting 當主詞，視為單數，否定用 doesn't mean，後接 you understand。
tip: 主詞是動名詞，否定用 doesn't + 原形。
say: Getting it right doesn't mean you understand it.

text: The scientist's findings were so _____ that other researchers quickly repeated the experiment.
options: significant
negligible
ordinary

wrong.negligible: negligible 是微不足道，不會讓其他研究者馬上重複實驗。
wrong.ordinary: ordinary 是普通的，與 so...that 所需的「重要到引起行動」不合。

why: so significant that ... 表示發現重要到使人立即行動，語意連貫。
tip: so + 形容詞 + that，看前後語意是否連貫。
say: The scientist's findings were so significant that other researchers quickly repeated the experiment.

prompt: 作者的 implied（暗示）意思是什麼？
text: The report listed ten complaints but did not mention a single solution.
options: 作者認為報告缺少解決辦法
作者認為報告提供了完整的解決辦法
作者不相信有任何問題
answer: 作者認為報告缺少解決辦法

wrong.作者認為報告提供了完整的解決辦法: did not mention a single solution 明確說沒有任何解決方案。
wrong.作者不相信有任何問題: 報告列出了十個抱怨，所以問題存在，作者批評的是缺少解法。

why: 句子沒有直接批評，但強調沒有任何解決方案，暗示報告不夠完整。
tip: 推論題：從語氣與細節找暗示。

prompt: 哪一句關係代名詞用法正確？
options: The student who won the prize is my cousin.
The student which won the prize is my cousin.
The student whose won the prize is my cousin.
answer: The student who won the prize is my cousin.

wrong.The student which won the prize is my co: 先行詞是人，要用 who 或 that，which 用於事物。
wrong.The student whose won the prize is my co: whose 後面要接名詞表示所有，這裡缺主詞，應該用 who。

why: 先行詞 the student 是人，且在子句中作主詞，用 who。
say: The student who won the prize is my cousin.

prompt: 同學問怎麼檢查作文，你想說「先檢查文法，再檢查拼字」。
options: First, check the grammar. Then, check the spelling.
First, check grammar. Then, to check spelling.
First check the grammar, then checking the spelling.
answer: First, check the grammar. Then, check the spelling.

wrong.First, check grammar. Then, to check spe: Then 後面要接完整祈使句 check the spelling，to check 不是完整句。
wrong.First check the grammar, then checking t: 兩個步驟應該用同樣的動詞形式，then 後面應用原形 check，不是 checking。

why: 順序步驟用 First...Then...，兩個祈使句保持平行結構。
tip: 並列步驟，動詞形式要一致。
say: First, check the grammar. Then, check the spelling.

text: Not until she heard the news _____ how serious it was.
options: did she realize
she realized
she did realize

wrong.she realized: Not until 放句首時，主要子句要倒裝，不能用一般語序。
wrong.she did realize: did 要放在主詞前面，she did realize 沒有倒裝。

why: Not until 子句放句首，主要子句倒裝為 did she realize。
tip: Not until 開頭，主要子句要倒裝。
say: Not until she heard the news did she realize how serious it was.
